terms.definition: A particle 1–100 nm across (a few hundred atoms).
PM10: particles 2.5 × 10⁻⁶ m to 1 × 10⁻⁵ m across, such as dust.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Fine particles (PM2.5) are 100–2500 nm.

terms.definition: As the side of a cube decreases by a factor of 10, its surface area to volume ratio increases by a factor of 10.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Nanoparticles have a high ratio, so smaller quantities are needed.

terms.definition: Medicine (drug delivery), electronics, cosmetics and sun creams, deodorants, and catalysts.
terms.examiner: Possible risks: long-term effects on health are not yet known.
